name: Context7 Up-to-date Docs
description: Fetches current, version-specific library documentation and code examples from Context7 (search, resolve library ID, get docs). Use when the user asks about a library or framework API, setup steps, or code generation that may be outdated in training data.
author: BMI AI Assistant

input.hint: Free API key from https://context7.com/dashboard for higher rate limits. Without a key, limits are low.

examples.prompt: How do I stream an OpenAI response from a Next.js route?
examples.call: {"query": "How do I stream an OpenAI response from a Next.js route?", "libraryName": "Next.js"}

examples.prompt: Show me the Supabase auth API for email/password sign-up
Next.js 16 proxy that checks JWT in cookies
examples.call: {"query": "proxy that checks JWT in cookies and redirects to login", "libraryId": "/vercel/next.js", "language": "TypeScript"}

query.description: Specific natural-language question about the library (specific questions rank best). Required.

libraryName.description: Library name to resolve first (e.g. Next.js, React, Supabase). Used with query when libraryId is unknown.

libraryId.description: Exact Context7 library ID, e.g. /vercel/next.js or /supabase/supabase. Skips the resolve step. Pin versions like /vercel/next.js/v16.2.9.

language.description: Programming language to rank code examples (e.g. TypeScript, Python). Optional.
